newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS THURSDAY MOSTLY FIRMER.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS THURSDAY MOSTLY FIRMER.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed firmer on most hard units on Thursday on the back of surplus foreign currency floating around the market, dealers said.

"The dollar depreciated to 10.5925/6125 at one point when a U.S. $1.8 million payment and a few others were made but fortunately the market had the money for it and when word got around that the payments had been settled everyone started selling their surplus cash," one dealer commented.
The local dollar finished the day at 10.5750/5950 against the U.S. unit, a one cent gain over Wednesday's 10.5850/6050 close and edged up to 17.1980/2410 from 17.2600/3200 against sterling.
It was at 6.9800/9950 versus the mark, up from 7.0500/0700 but slipped to 2.2430/2500 from 2.2300/2400 against the South African rand.
